familiar_pattern: Existing instructions implement the old named team workflow; the explicit solo override needs coordinated prose changes.
precise_scope: User explicitly removes offline ownership/messages/approvals; contract limits edits to instructions and capability evidence.
localized_change: AGENTS.md, branch process, active decision index and affected kit project guidance/catalog only; no app/runtime/model policy edit.
deterministic_checks: kit_skills validate/resolve/preflight, kit_hooks check and diff review verify changed guidance and freshness.
low_risk: Instruction-only alignment to explicit user direction; preserve all local review gates, technical/security/data constraints and configured model policy. No executable process configuration or auth change.
no_prior_failure: No repair attempt or unexplained implementation failure on this instruction correction.
ambiguity_resolved: Latest user confirms Codex works alone with local kit subagents; prior explicit integration target is v1-integration.
